title: Normalized section equations for line preparation
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $F,X$ algebraic spaces over $S$ with their small etale sites [def-trf-algebraic-space], and $M,N$ module sheaves. Use ordinary/etale identifications and canonical overlap transport [def-sfb-ordinary-etale-identification], Zariski restriction [def-trf-space-module-scheme-restriction], and the unit-normalized tensor composition maps [def-trf-tensor-sections-unit-composition]. Define the following six existing equations. (1) A restriction identification is normalized if, on every open chart, the tensor unit followed by the identification sends each section to itself. (2) A family of identifications induces specified overlap isomorphisms if their transported actions on every localized etale test agree with those identifications. (3) The pulled transition is the original transition pulled back to the new overlap, conjugated by both tensor-composition comparisons. (4) The composite-section map is the tensor-composition comparison followed by transport along the given equality of composite scheme maps. (5) A realization is unique if every other line-module realization inducing the same transitions admits exactly one isomorphism respecting all chart identifications on every localized etale test. (6) For an etale map $k:X\to F$, the etale comparison is the unique isomorphism from $N$ to the etale restriction of $M$ whose chartwise action is the original identification applied after the composite-section map. These are predicates and maps, not assertions of their existence.
